 Rain returns to Houston check out Sunday’s shower timeline
 Rain lingers into the early week
 Daji Aswad , Meteorologist / Reporter
 Justin Stapleton , Meteorologist
 Published:  November 7, 2026 at 7:52 AM Updated:  November 7, 2026 at 7:09 PM Tags:  forecast , Houston weather , Fall , November Rain Returns to Houston Sunday Sunday rain timeline: 
 Sunday will see a disturbance moving in from west Texas that brings in light to moderate rain across southeast Texas. The steadiest and heaviest rain will set up west and south of Houston. 
 Sunday's rain (Copyright 2025 by KPRC Click2Houston - All rights reserved.) Here is a closer look at the timeline- Sunday morning showers mainly west of Houston. 
 Bulk of the rain still mainly west of Houston Expect to see some dry time in the late morning and afternoon before showers return through Sunday evening. 
 Mostly dry with spotty showers passing through Showers scattered across southeast Texas Drying out for most, lingering showers south of I-10 Tracking the tropics: 
 The remainder of this hurricane season will limp to the finish line. Currently there are no disturbances developing in the Atlantic basin. 
 No disturbances to worry about The extended forecast: 
 This fall feel will stay through the next 10 days. Our average high for this time of year is 76°, and we’re pretty close to this through next weekend. And I don’t have a morning temperature above 60°.
